svg.title: Annotated AST of a dependently-typed multi-dispatch function
svg.desc: A holographic syntax tree for function transfer: a refined dependent signature on the left, a three-arm multi-dispatch body with proof receipts on the right, and three verification badges (conservation, no-halt totality, receipt graph) hanging beneath the parts of the tree they check.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the FnDecl root node and what ⟨n:ℕ⟩, @total and @conserve attach to it in the AST.')
sendPrompt('Walk through the signature subtree: the refinement type on src, the dependent ℕ parameter, and the conserves clause on the return type.')
sendPrompt('Explain the multi-dispatch body node: how does Pontif select an arm from the (kind, kind) pair of argument types?')
sendPrompt('What is a refinement type like Account{bal ≥ amt}, and how does the dependent value amt enter src’s type at this AST node?')
sendPrompt('What does ℚ⁺ (positive rational) as a parameter type buy the proof checker here?')
sendPrompt('Explain the return type node and the conserves Σ bal clause as a proposition over the result.')
sendPrompt('Explain the first dispatch arm: pattern (Checking, Checking), the fast_path body, and receipt R12.')
sendPrompt('How does matching the Frozen pattern perform type narrowing on dst in this arm, and why does the body type ⊥ discharge the obligation by ⊥-elimination?')
sendPrompt('Explain the catch-all arm (k, k′) → clearing() and receipt R47, including how the dependent kinds k, k′ stay general here.')
sendPrompt('Explain the conservation check: how Pontif proves Σ of input balances equals Σ of output balances across every dispatch arm.')
sendPrompt('Explain the no-halt / totality check: what well-founded measure decreases so every arm is guaranteed to terminate?')
sendPrompt('Explain the visual receipts: what is the ReceiptGraph, what do R12, ⊥-elim and R47 attest, and how does 3/3 verified close the function?')
